covers: INT 10h, the video BIOS: every function and subfunction the emulator's INT10_Handler has a case for, VESA included.

entries.name: set video mode
entries.description: Sets the video mode in AL, reprogramming the adapter and, unless AL bit 7 is set, clearing video memory.
entries.behaviour: AL = mode, bit 7 set means keep video memory. A mode the machine type does not have (above 13h on standard VGA, above 06h on CGA, above 0Ah on Tandy and PCjr) changes nothing and reports no error. AL is never modified; with DOS/V or J-3100 active, modes 03h, 70h-73h and 78h select the emulator's Japanese text modes.
entries.differs: The list returns a mode flag in AL on Phoenix and AMI BIOSes; the emulator leaves AL as the caller passed it.

entries.name: set cursor shape
entries.description: Sets the start and end scan lines of the text-mode hardware cursor.
entries.behaviour: CH = start line (bits 6-5 = 01h hides the cursor), CL = end line. The emulator stores CH:CL in the BIOS data area and writes CRTC registers 0Ah and 0Bh. Except on CGA, Olivetti, 3270PC, Tandy and PCjr machines, with cursor emulation on (AH=12h BL=34h) CGA-style values are first rescaled to the current font height.

entries.name: set cursor position
entries.description: Moves the text cursor of display page BH to row DH, column DL.
entries.behaviour: The emulator stores the position in the BIOS data area for page BH and, if BH is the active page, programs CRTC registers 0Eh and 0Fh. Row and column are not range-checked. DOS/V and J-3100 Japanese text modes force page 0.

entries.name: get cursor position
entries.description: Returns the cursor position of display page BH and the cursor shape.
entries.behaviour: BH = page. Returns DH = row and DL = column of that page from the BIOS data area, and CX = the cursor shape last stored by AH=01h (CH start, CL end), not read back from the CRTC. AX is not changed.
entries.differs: The list says AX is 0000h on Phoenix BIOSes; the emulator leaves AX unchanged.

entries.name: scroll window up
entries.description: Scrolls the window CH,CL to DH,DL up by AL lines, filling the new lines with attribute BH.
entries.behaviour: AL = 0 clears the window. The emulator clamps the lower-right corner to the screen, does nothing if the upper-left corner lies beyond the lower-right, and scrolls the page at the current start address. It handles text, CGA, Tandy, EGA and mode 13h screens; any other mode type is logged as unhandled.

entries.name: scroll window down
entries.description: Scrolls the window CH,CL to DH,DL down by AL lines, filling the new lines with attribute BH.
entries.behaviour: AL = 0 clears the window. Same code as AH=06h with the direction reversed: the lower-right corner is clamped to the screen, an inverted window does nothing, and only text, CGA, Tandy, EGA and mode 13h screens are scrolled.

entries.name: read char and attribute
entries.description: Returns the character, and in text modes its attribute, at the cursor position of page BH.
entries.behaviour: In text modes AL = character and AH = attribute from video memory. In CGA, Tandy and EGA/VGA graphics modes the emulator matches the pixels at the cursor against the font tables and returns AL = character, AH = 0, or AL = 0 if none matches. BH = FFh means the current page; BH is ignored in one-page modes.

entries.name: write graphics pixel

entries.name: read graphics pixel

entries.name: teletype output

entries.behaviour: BL = colour in graphics modes; text modes keep the attribute. Codes 07h (a beep, length set by the beep duration option), 08h, 0Ah (no carriage return) and 0Dh are interpreted. BH is ignored and the active page used; a scroll off the bottom fills with the attribute at the cursor in text modes, black in graphics.

entries.name: restore video state
entries.description: Restores the video states chosen in CX from the buffer at ES:BX.
entries.behaviour: VGA only. CX bits 0-2 select hardware, BIOS data area (with four vectors) and DAC to reload using the block offsets in the buffer header; none set returns AL=0, else AL=1Ch. The buffer is not validated.
